query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Analyze WhatsApp-style broadcast campaigns in Kommo CRM, including detected campaign sends, audience reach, replies, conversions, templates, segments, and related agent activity.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Enables interaction with customers through the WhatsApp Business API for messaging and automation. Only supports WhatsApp Business accounts, not WhatsApp Personal accounts.
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=whatsapp. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="whatsapp") to create a connection BEFORE executing any whatsapp tools.

WHATSAPP_GET_ACTIVITIES.description: Retrieve activity history for a WhatsApp Business Account. This action returns a paginated list of activities such as phone number verifications, user additions, and other administrative actions performed on the WABA. Use this action when you need to audit administrative actions, track changes to your WhatsApp Business Account, or monitor user access and modifications.

after.description: Cursor for pagination. Use this to get the next page of results.

limit.description: Maximum number of activity records to return per page. Default is 25, maximum is 100.

since.description: Unix timestamp or ISO 8601 date string. Only return activities that occurred after this time.

until.description: Unix timestamp or ISO 8601 date string. Only return activities that occurred before this time.

before.description: Cursor for pagination. Use this to get the previous page of results.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Default includes all available fields.

waba_id.description: Optional: WhatsApp Business Account ID to query. If not provided, uses the waba_id from your connection configuration.

activity_type.description: Filter activities by type. Can be a single type or comma-separated list of types (e.g., PHONE_NUMBER_VERIFIED,USER_ADDED).

time_info.message:
